entries.dialogueText: "We have a very significant amount of money flowing into our economy. This is a great indicator for the future."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.dialogueText: "As already mentioned, living standards in Rizia are in a very healthy position as a result of a combination of economic policies."

entries.dialogueText: "However, we are rapidly losing money. We should try to get out of our current deficit situation."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We also have some reserves with wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We also have some reserves with which we can fund projects."

entries.dialogueText: "But at the moment, we don't have any money to spend on new projects."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.dialogueText: "And unfortunately, we lack the funds to make any improvements."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned a page."
entries.dialogueText: She turned a page.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Of course, the war has influenced..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, the war has influenced my department very negatively, to say the least."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""While the war profits tax is helpi..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the war profits tax is helping with our immediate finances, it is stifling the growth of our economy. This may have lasting effects."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The war expenses are putting a cri..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war expenses are putting a crimp in our economy. If this continues for much longer, it may have a lasting impact on our growth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want to hear excuses. I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to hear excuses. I want to hear solutions and results."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your comments are appreciated, Ms...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your comments are appreciated, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are doing our best to end the w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are doing our best to end the war as quickly as possible."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I don't doubt it, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't doubt it, Your Majesty. I know our military will come out on top."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Unfortunately, the energy crisis c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the energy crisis continues with no end in sight. I believe this should be our most significant concern."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""As long as our industries' energy..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as our industries' energy demands are not being met, they will not operate at full capacity. And our economy will suffer for it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Fortunately, we've managed to resc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, we've managed to rescue ourselves from the energy crisis of a few years ago. The demands of our industries are finally being met."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'm pleased to say our production..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm pleased to say our production capacity has increased significantly."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Unfortunately, we are still only s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we are still only seeing average production capacity. This is something to work on."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I am afraid our production capacit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am afraid our production capacity has already suffered significantly."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Fortunately, our production capaci..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, our production capacity hasn't collapsed just yet -- which is surprising."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""With the current wave of robust ec..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the current wave of robust economic growth, buoyed by market incentives to attract fresh investments, we are witnessing the formation of thousands of new businesses."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""In light of the recent slowdown in..."
entries.dialogueText: "In light of the recent slowdown in growth, paired with forecasts suggesting the potential onset of a recession next year, we are observing a notable decline in investment activities."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""As we find ourselves increasingly..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we find ourselves increasingly mired in what appears to be a deepening recession, there is an alarming trend of substantial withdrawal of investments across the board."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""So far, we have managed to greatly..."
entries.dialogueText: "So far, we have managed to greatly diversify our energy sources. This helps our economic options."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Despite this, however, the energy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite this, however, the energy crisis continues with no end in sight. Tackling this should be our number-one concern."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Currently, we have a very rigid en..."
entries.dialogueText: "Currently, we have a very rigid energy economy with heavy reliance on certain sources. Our future is looking strong -- as long as access to those resources remains."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""So far, we seem to have a mixed en..."
entries.dialogueText: "So far, we seem to have a mixed energy economy. But I believe we must diversify our sources further in order to cover potential weaknesses."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Therefore, the energy crisis conti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, the energy crisis continues with no end in sight. I believe this should be our most significant concern."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Despite this, however, we've manag..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite this, however, we've managed to dig ourselves out of the energy crisis. The demands of our industries are finally being met."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is worrying news. I'll look i..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is worrying news. I'll look into ways to solve this energy crisis."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Surprising? Are you saying you exp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surprising? Are you saying you expect our production to collapse?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for sharing this, Ms. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for sharing this, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is a significant problem. Wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a significant problem. What should we do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is worrying news. I'll look i..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is worrying news. I'll look into ways to increase our production capacity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for sharing this, Ms. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for sharing this, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is still good news. Thank you..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is still good news. Thank you for your contributions, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is great news. Thank you for..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is great news. Thank you for all your contributions, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good to know."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We should either seek new sources..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should either seek new sources of energy or improve our current extraction capacity. Or both."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If the energy crisis continues, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the energy crisis continues, that is our projection, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We could look to our neighbors. Pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could look to our neighbors. Perhaps we can work out an import deal."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""When you ascended the throne, we s..."
entries.dialogueText: "When you ascended the throne, we set a focus to diversify the Rizian economy away from resources."

entries.dialogueText: "When you ascended the throne, we set a focus to further the Rizian resource economy."

entries.dialogueText: "When you ascended the throne, we agreed to focus on a mixed approach for the Rizian economy -- balancing resources and other industries."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Jobs are being created; employment..."
entries.dialogueText: "Jobs are being created; employment rates are skyrocketing. It's a good time to be an entrepreneur in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""This downturn is harming new busin..."
entries.dialogueText: "This downturn is harming new businesses and forcing cutbacks, resulting in a shrinking job market and posing serious challenges to our economic stability."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""This economic climate is dire for..."
entries.dialogueText: "This economic climate is dire for new businesses, leading to increased insolvencies and a significant rise in unemployment, which is severely impacting our workforce and marking a tough phase for Rizia’s overall economic health."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May the Lord guide us through thes..."
entries.dialogueText: "May the Lord guide us through these fiscally trying times and set us once more on a path to prosperity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "This is disconcerting news. We must act decisively to prevent our country from faltering."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We couldn't have done it without you, Ms. Werner. You should be proud."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "As long as nobody makes *too* much money. We don't want another Rusty on our hands."

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That's an incredible gesture of tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's an incredible gesture of trust, Your Majesty. I will not let you down."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Thank you for your gesture of trus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your gesture of trust, Your Majesty. I'll be sure to use these funds judiciously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And a horrible time to be a worker.""
entries.dialogueText: "And a horrible time to be a worker."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There must be additional strategie..."
entries.dialogueText: "There must be additional strategies we can employ, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have reserves in our treasury...."
entries.dialogueText: "We have reserves in our treasury. Let’s strategically invest them to bolster our economic standing."
entries.menuText: "We have reserves in our treasury. Let’s strategically invest them to bolster our economic standing." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Allocate several billion guilders..."
entries.dialogueText: "Allocate several billion guilders to mitigate this economic downturn. I entrust you with overseeing this crucial initiative."
entries.menuText: "Allocate several billion guilders to mitigate this economic downturn. I entrust you with overseeing this crucial initiative." [-4 Budget]

entries.dialogueText: "You're too modest, Your Majesty. You had the final say on all of these decisions."

entries.dialogueText: "Rusty was a special case, Your Majesty. I foresee only gains coming from this growth."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.dialogueText: "We've been over this, Your Majesty. If you want to improve workers' rights, I will assist you."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.dialogueText: "I agree wholeheartedly. I'm exploring every possible option to strengthen our economy further."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Rest assured, I am fully dedicated..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured, I am fully dedicated to preventing any further economic decline."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Yes. In the meantime, I will see w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. In the meantime, I will see what I can do."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We have a small budget surplus at..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have a small budget surplus at the moment. This isn't a bad indicator for our economy."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Sadly, our goods are no longer in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sadly, our goods are no longer in demand around the country and the world. Our industrial production capacity has fallen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not worried. We will bounce ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not worried. We will bounce back eventually."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Unfortunately, however, we are now..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, however, we are now slipping into an energy crisis. I believe this must be our most significant concern."

entries.dialogueText: Elena looked at them both uneasily.

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We should not underestimate the di..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should not underestimate the difficulty of this endeavor. The resources we spend on nationalizing RRG may not be worth the long-term gains."

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Be that as it may, we should not u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be that as it may, we should not underestimate the difficulty of this endeavor. The resources we spend on nationalizing RRG may not be worth the long-term gains."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: She paused thoughtfully.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Nationalization would allow us to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nationalization would allow us to extract more value from it, it's true. But at quite a large upfront cost."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Then again, if your goal is to kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then again, if your goal is to keep the left-wingers in the RPP from causing a stir, taking Rizia's most renowned corporation out of private hands might do the trick. For a while."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have the feeling Soletato's peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have the feeling Soletato's people will not be appeased that easily."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato is a former miner, isn't he? It'll make him happy to see his ex-boss lose everything."

entries.dialogueText: "Nationalization means putting RRG *into* the hands of the Royal Family. They'd hate that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So all of a sudden a ragtag bunch..."
entries.dialogueText: "So all of a sudden a ragtag bunch of radicals are more important to please than Rizian business owners?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, and there are other ways to deal with Sotelato."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Maybe not. But in combination with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe not. But in combination with other policies, perhaps..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father. Do you really think the re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father. Do you really think the reformists are that petty?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Happy enough to drop his threats a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Happy enough to drop his threats against the crown? I doubt it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course not, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With that said, nationalization is..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that said, nationalization isn't as complicated as Ms. Werner is making it out to be. A swift raid on Montoro's Bronaz palace, and we'll have all the necessary assets secured before he can blink."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There are other ways to deal with..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are other ways to deal with Sotelato. We don't need to acknowledge the demands of him or his 'movement'."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Please, Your Highness. Sotelato's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Highness. Sotelato's no more of a saint than Manus Sazon was. But we shouldn't feel compelled to nationalize RRG solely on his behalf."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If I may chime in, nationalization..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may chime in, nationalization isn't as complicated as Ms. Werner is making it out to be. A swift raid on Montoro's Bronaz palace, and we'll have all the necessary assets secured before he can blink."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Sotelato's no saint, Your Highness..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato's no saint, Your Highness. But we shouldn't feel compelled to nationalize RRG solely on his behalf."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rusty put his heart and soul into..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rusty put his heart and soul into RRG. If we're to nationalize, he and the other stakeholders should be justly compensated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A dangerous proposition, Duchess A..."
entries.dialogueText: "A dangerous proposition, Duchess Azaro. What if he and his guards get wind of the operation?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Montoro was just starting to becom..."
entries.dialogueText: "Montoro was just starting to become useful to me. I don't want to throw away our cooperation."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Sensible, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sensible, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That will take manpower. We can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "That will take manpower. We can't afford to pull people from the front lines."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""His heart and soul... As if Montor..."
entries.dialogueText: "His heart and soul... As if Montoro was in possession of either."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There's always that risk. We'd hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's always that risk. We'd have to make wise use of our intelligence services to gauge the situation."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Compensation would put Rizia's oth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Compensation would put Rizia's other business owners at ease. But I fear Montoro won't grant us even that opportunity unless he is forced to."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With sufficient intelligence, we c..."
entries.dialogueText: "With sufficient intelligence, we can complete the task with a small core team."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena looked around the table."
entries.dialogueText: Elena looked around the table.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It is His Majesty's decision. I ad..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is His Majesty's decision. I admit we could use the extra budget."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It is His Majesty's decision. Keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is His Majesty's decision. Keeping in mind that we don't strictly need the extra budget."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For the security of the kingdom, i..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the security of the kingdom, it is vital that we nationalize Rizian Royal Gold. Lucita, you have my permission to act."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd like to thank His Grace Hugo f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to thank His Grace Hugo for bringing up the matter. Rusty's had this coming for a long time. I say we do it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am satisfied with the Crown's cu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am satisfied with the Crown's current stake in Rizian Royal Gold. Nationalization is not worth the effort."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Very good, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Very good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With the current state of our inte..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the current state of our intelligence services, this is a risk we cannot afford to take. We will leave RRG alone."
